Current human participants, including provider identities awaiting account linking. The connections to share it with, by Muse ID. Optional retry identity. Reuse it when retrying this same share. The Muse ID of the connection who shared it (the host). The Space's slug on the host; open it at

 Returned only by the single-episode GET; omitted from list responses so a

 episode shape so the in-cell helper can round-trip episode records directly. Public URL of the user's personal Spotify show

 in precedence order: `episode_url` (resolves a single episode), then

 per-finding detail (see `publish_share_block_message`), so it cannot be

 against the content -- an inference outage or an unreachable Sentinel.
 The artifact is left unreviewed, so the publish is refused but a later
 attempt can still clear it. Callers may surface this as retryable. Result of the pre-publish content review for a podcast episode's script.
 `allowed == false` means the publish must not
